title: Research Assessment Deadline
description: The Research Assessment is a quiz covering core Research 101 topics. To help you prepare, we will be hosting a dedicated bootcamp. Every participant who completes the assessment will receive a Certificate of Participation displaying their exact score.
rules: First, check your category to ensure you are in the correct group. The Junior category is for students in grades 7 through 12, as well as those on a gap year who have graduated from high school or A-levels but are not currently enrolled in any institution. The Senior category is for anyone from their first day of a bachelor's program onward, including adults of any age and independent learners, even if you are not currently in school. If your current registration does not match your situation, please contact us to update it right away, because once you take the Research Assessment, your category can no longer be changed.
The assessment window is open from September 10–15, 2026.
You will take the test in a secure, proctored environment featuring randomized questions with multiple variations.
All forms of unauthorized assistance are strictly prohibited; opening or switching tabs, as well as using keyboard shortcuts, is disabled within the assessment platform.
Upon completing the assessment, you will automatically receive a Certificate of Participation.
Screen recording is active throughout the session, and all decisions regarding policy violations are final.

title: Proposal Submission Deadline
description: The Research Proposal is the main research submission. It must be a maximum of 5 pages excluding cover page, title, citations, and references. Information on how to write a proposal and what to include will be provided in the bootcamps and further communication.
rules: Maximum 2-5 pages excluding cover page, title, citations and references.
Follow the official proposal formatting guidelines.

title: Video Pitch Submission Deadline
description: The top 50+50 Finalists must submit a 2.5-5 minute-long video submission. The Video Pitch should state the proposal's research question or objective and introduce the research process and potential future research avenues.
rules: Include your research question or objective.
Review the assessment guidelines before submission.
